plainTranslation: A's identity meets B's identity. The opposition pulls them into push-and-pull.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Your core directions rub against each other, wanting different things at the same time. Respect can curdle into a contest of wills. Take turns being the one who's right.
tension: The harder part is when the difference stops feeling interesting and starts feeling frustrating. You do things one way, they do things another, and before long both of you are explaining, defending, or pushing back. What began as contrast can turn into a pattern where each person feels misunderstood by the other.
advice: You do not have to agree on everything to respect each other. The difference becomes much easier to live with when neither person is trying to prove their way is the right one.
summaryShort: Your core directions rub against each other, wanting different things at the same time.
